title: Quentin and the Cover
author: Bram Thornbury
blurb: August Sterling, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
